newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * President Emil Constantinescu met French European Affairs minister Michel Barnier to discuss Romania's integration in NATO, ties with France and the planned visit of French President Jacques Chirac to Romania. Barnier had also talks with Foreign Minister Adrian Severin.
* Lower house of deputies continued debates on draft law on staff employed in educational system.

* Opposition Social Democracy Party (PDSR) plans to set up an anti-crisis board to find solutions to Romania's economic crisis, PDSR president Ion Iliescu told a news conferrence. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
